headline: New Update! - version 1.3.0 - 1.3.1
openingRemarks: Social Sharing, Kayaking, and Database Fixes

newFeatures.title: Social Sharing
newFeatures.description: You can now share to Facebook, Facebook Messenger, Twitter, Reddit, or Email from the profile screen or the footer.

newFeatures.title: Kayaking now available as a Water Activity
newFeatures.description: Kayaking will now grant water points instead of just being a regular workout.

bugFixes: Fixed bug where if you spent points on Health in the QP window and you were at full health, you wouldn't regenerate your newly added health points
Fixed bug where Shadow Self wasn't accessible after level 20
Fixed display bug where on season change, the wrong element was highlighted for the bonus in the Battle Report Detail
Fixed bug where sometimes the last value in the 'Damage Received' column shows the incorrect value
Fixed display bug where some devices couldn't see the top of the Battle Report Detail window
balanceChanges: Lowered Photon Tokens earned from winning battles.
Made foes more difficult to compensate for the Big balance update to Heroes in the previous patch
miscDetails: Big Database changes with items. It's nothing players will notice but this change was crucial to the scalability of the game going forward
Now limiting the number of activities visible on the Training screen to 250
closingRemarks: Big announcement coming soon regarding the development path moving through the next few months, stay tuned!
